chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Shy young Louis Armstrong on the boat
summary: Marge met a shy Louis Armstrong on Marable's boat, who ran from the girls to the water fountain; Zutty adds he collected gum wrappers and spilled his olives in the station.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: He was the man, see he was the king, you know. Did the whole season on the St. Paul and took it to dry dock in Iowa with Charlie, so then when we came back to St. Louis that's when the work first started, just coming in. I hadn't even met Zutty then. Because Zutty wasn't on the boat, I was on the boat before Zutty. I met Louie Armstrong on the boat, not just -- he played with Fate Marable's band, we'd go on there on Monday night, and Louie Armstrong was so shy he'd jump over that bandstand and run downstairs to the water fountain trying to get away from the girls, you know. And I wanted to talk with him because Charlie was a trumpet player, too, you know, and so I introduced myself to him that I was Charlie's sister, you know, and all, and he just kept his head down.
He was collecting gum wrappers then. He used to have a coupon on the back of a package of gum, and that's what he was looking for, and that's--
But that's where I met him.

But when he first came to St. Louis they had a bottle of olives, see, and when he got off of the train why this bottle slipped and these olives started to rolling all over the station floor, and he tried to pick each one up.
It was really a sort of very unique
But when I met Zutty I had been with Charlie's band for about four years, you know, and --
